title: Grocy
descript: Grocy is a self-hosted household management tool: track what is in the pantry and fridge, what expires when, shopping lists, recipes with stock consumption, chores, a battery tracker and price history. Everything is stored in a local SQLite database in the application data folder.
release_note: 1. First release: Grocy 4.7.1 from Docker Hub (LinuxServer image) as a non-root container. Household, stock, recipes and chores management with SQLite in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). Open the UI, choose SQLite and finish the setup - the database and configuration live in DockerAppData/grocydockerdocker/config/data. Set the timezone in the setup wizard. Plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.

github.description: A container for grocy - the ERP application for your kitchen https://grocy.info

wrapper_note:
the LinuxServer image serves the app with nginx on port 80, which uid 1000
cannot bind. This wrapper runs the same PHP application with the built-in PHP web
server on port 8080 and keeps the data folder on the mounted volume.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper**: serves the app with `php -S 0.0.0.0:8080` (nginx binds 80, unusable as uid 1000) and points `GROCY_DATA_DIR` at the mounted volume.

zh-cn.descript: Grocy 是自建的家庭管理工具：记录储藏室和冰箱里有什么、什么时候过期，管理购物清单、带库存消耗的食谱、家务任务、电池记录与价格历史。所有数据都存在应用数据目录里的本地 SQLite 数据库。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。打开界面，选择 SQLite 完成初始化——数据库与配置保存在 DockerAppData/grocydockerdocker/config/data。初始化时记得设置时区。界面为纯 HTTP，暴露到公网前请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub（LinuxServer 镜像）的 Grocy 4.7.1，以非 root 容器运行。家庭库存、食谱与家务管理，SQLite 数据保存在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: Grocy 是自建的家庭管理工具：記錄儲藏室和冰箱裡有什麼、什麼時候過期，管理購物清單、帶庫存消耗的食譜、家務任務、電池記錄與價格歷史。所有資料都存在應用資料目錄裡的本機 SQLite 資料庫。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。開啟介面，選擇 SQLite 完成初始化——資料庫與設定保存在 DockerAppData/grocydockerdocker/config/data。初始化時記得設定時區。介面為純 HTTP，公開到互聯網前請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub（LinuxServer 映像）的 Grocy 4.7.1，以非 root 容器運行。家庭庫存、食譜與家務管理，SQLite 資料保存在應用資料目錄。

design_notes: **PHP built-in server.** nginx binds port 80, unusable as uid 1000; `php -S` serves the app on 8080.
**Data dir via env.** `GROCY_DATA_DIR` points the SQLite database at the mounted volume.
limitations: - The built-in PHP server is single-threaded; fine for a household.
- Barcode scanning needs an extra app and API key configuration.
- The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
